item.description: A shooter unleashed a flurry of bullets during a Rhode Island youth hockey game, killing two people and injuring three others, in an attack that was cut short when a spectator stepped in to help stop the tragedy, authorities said. item.title: WalletHub: Providence 17th-best state capital to live in
item.description: PROVIDENCE – The city is the 17th-best state capital in the nation to live in, according to a recent study by WalletHub. item.description: SOUTH KINGSTOWN – The University of Rhode Island has received $210,000 from the van Beuren Charitable Foundation to better protect against storm-driven erosion and flooding in coastal communities.
